problem: On the reconstructed LibreCAD_3 candidate, a default-normal elevated HATCH with line-edge boundaries imported at Z=0; saving and reopening also lost its source elevation. A generated control failed before the patch.

authority.title: Autodesk HATCH (DXF)
authority.scope: HATCH and MPOLYGON share an OCS elevation and extrusion.

authority.title: Autodesk Boundary Path Data (DXF)
authority.scope: Line endpoints and polyline vertices in boundary paths are 2D OCS coordinates.

patch.base: Incremental patch against the candidate reconstructed from LibreCAD_3 master 4fb48312708b39d499f7e6668104a3b54a8601c7, after the prior ordered P8 MPOLYGON, ABI, lineweight and two elevation patches. Not standalone on master.
patch.application: git apply --check and apply PASS against isolated exact preimages; patched files byte-match the tested files. Existing user LibreCAD_3 checkout untouched.
patch.implementation: Lift eligible default-normal line endpoints onto the entity OCS elevation; infer output elevation across eligible line-edge and one-polyline paths via a shared finite, equal-Z check. Mixed or nonfinite checked elevations retain the existing loss note and do not fabricate a plane.

validation.baseline: Generated three-line nonzero-elevation HATCH fails the import and ASCII/Binary reopen checks without the patch.
validation.focused: 6/6 tests pass for both current installed shared codec and bundled codec: line-edge ASCII/Binary import/save/reopen, mixed line/polyline loops, mixed-elevation loss warning and corrected same-document retry, and four prior MPOLYGON/HATCH controls.
validation.dynamicLoad: DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES confirms the test loads the newly built current shared codec.
validation.independentReader: ezdxf 1.4.5 checks physical ASCII/Binary signatures, group-30 elevation and all three XY line endpoints for normal output, mixed-elevation fallback and corrected retry for both codec builds.

limits: This is an unmerged downstream incremental patch and does not qualify LibreCAD_3 GUI behavior, other platforms or full output.

Tilted planes, DWG MPOLYGON mapping, and non-line edge elevation inference remain outside this patch. ARC, ELLIPSE and SPLINE edge paths still require a separate source, import/export and loss-reporting audit.
The mixed-elevation route reports loss and writes a flattened fallback; the retry test does not claim atomic refusal. No DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
